imagery.method: Reviewed independent zoom-19 imagery captures for all 25 eligible Fire/EMS sites at average scale 0.220 m/pixel. Each rectangle follows the visible building, immediate paved apron/parking and site access aisle; fit dimensions and rotation are estimates, not surveyed boundaries.

roads.assessment: Packaged road/service geometry was reviewed with imagery. Runtime QA follows an actual response route through the fitted-yard boundary; mapped graph segments do not verify private driveway rights or apparatus doors.

limits: No official station parcel or building-footprint polygons were used.
Dimensions, centers, rotations and modeled spawn coordinates are imagery/road-geometry estimates, not surveyed measurements.
Imagery does not verify apparatus bays, access controls, current pavement, occupancy or driveway rights.
Canonical IDs and source coordinates remain unchanged.

Collision QA follows a real route from the modeled spawn until at least 10 m outside the expanded fitted yard and checks movement in 1.5 m increments; it verifies the modeled collision transition, not sustained manual driving or real-world emergency-response suitability.
A shared Fire/EMS fit denotes an identical official address and source coordinate; it does not identify an EMS-only bay or entrance.
